figures.finding: Saint-Barthélemy has no actors' agreement of its own: French labour law, including its rules on collective agreements, applies there as in metropolitan France, so a actor is engaged on France's terms.
figures.applies: Saint-Barthélemy (BL), actors; France's terms are in the FR market files.
